purpose: Replay of July L07 (PAP-20260729-RESEARCH-L07) on the current runtime without cache_salt (R-002 E2b, X-002 option 1).

derivation.change: Prepend 'Session <NNN> (<session_id>).\n' to each session's first turn.
derivation.reason: Every first-turn document is a prefix of the same corpus text (pairwise common prefix median 3614 of 4023 tokens). July isolated sessions with cache_salt, which PAP's Dynamo integration rejects; a distinct first line makes every chained block hash session-specific.

july_reference.relation: Same generator parameters and seed; sampled append mean 697.338 matches the L07 report. Not byte-compared (original file not found). July carried cache_salt per turn; this file instead isolates sessions by a header line (about 10 extra tokens per session).
